race.comment: STEFFI ELECTRICA (13) rewarded for her consistency with a dominant on-pace win over 1006m at Grafton in a fast-run contest. Looks well placed again with the claim and has the class to overcome the awkward draw. Hard to stop. WANJINA ROSE (8) slow into stride and failed to get into the contest when ninth over this trip at the Gold Coast. Best figures measure up nicely. Each way. HUMPHREE BEAR (12) resumed with a tidy fourth over 1000m at Grafton. Finds a suitable assignment and can take this out. BEER BARON (11) drifted back from a good draw last time then he wound up strongly to score a nose win over 1100m at Grafton. Good record at this journey and worth thought.
